name: pre-arbiter
why: The reading taken before the finding arbiter was wired into the filing path (#1261). Once adjudication gates `gh issue create`, the set of findings that reach the tracker changes, and a run taken afterwards is measuring a different regime.
comparableWith: NOT a drop-in `before` arm for a temporal comparison. `compareReviewOutcomes` refuses unequal populations by design, and a post-arbiter tracker run is a different population, so loading this against one returns UNMEASURED — correctly. What this artefact IS: the outcome distribution of findings actually filed under the pre-arbiter regime. The comparison that prices the arbiter is the same-population one the module was built for — score the adjudicated candidate batch twice, once with nothing suppressed and once with the arbiter withholding applied, so the two arms differ only in `suppressed`.

summary.filter: every issue in hornjason/pai-harness (627 findings, #23..#1278), scored against 1237 commits on origin/main. Pull requests are excluded: the tracker is the finding surface here. Plants: #1169, #473, #547, #23.
summary.citationFilter: a citing commit counts only if it is dated at or after the finding was filed (PREDATES_FILING) and changed at least one file (CHANGED_NOTHING)
